name: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
mechanism: Observe radio-frequency responses of selected nuclear spins in a stable magnetic field to distinguish resolved chemical environments.
operating_requirement: Build and calibrate a field source, homogeneous sample region, RF excitation/probe and sensitive detection; pay power, thermal control, sample preparation, reference material and acquisition time, with explicit resolution and sensitivity limits.
consequence: A qualified analytical bench supplies sample-specific spectral evidence to polymer composition or sequence review only when the selected signals are resolved; unavailable or ambiguous evidence cannot certify a grade or reveal arbitrary molecular structure.
branching_note: These are selected game production pathways, not claims that other historical implementations are impossible. All listed foundations apply; knowledge never supplies equipment or materials.
recovery: Acquire attributable nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy instruction or working samples, then pay for local setup and acceptance trials.
